title: SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR of the whole leap year 2024 is the whole of 2023
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( VAR R = SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( 'Date'[Date] ) RETURN ROW ( "Min", MINX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Max", MAXX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Days", COUNTROWS ( R ), "Sales", CALCULATE ( [Sales], R ) ), 'Date'[Date] >= DATE ( 2024, 1, 1 ) && 'Date'[Date] <= DATE ( 2024, 12, 31 ) )

source.quote: Internally SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR corresponds to the following call of DATEADD :
If all the days of the month are selected, then the entire month is shifted by the number of intervals specified.
source.supports: a fully selected month moves as a whole month

derivation: All 366 days of 2024 are selected, so every month is complete and moves as a whole month: the result is all of 2023, 365 days (February has 28). Sales in 2023: 360.
